answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity must be backed by a registered operator whose real legal entity posts an escrow that is shared across every identity it runs. Any identity proven fraudulent triggers a proportional draw on that single escrow, like a river draining one basin, not per-wallet slashing. A flagged inlet of spam collapses the operator's whole credit line. The trellis of trust is the operator's registry record. Cost: one attacker pays once per operator, losing capacity for all identities at once.
